title: The Pickpocket
text: A child in a porcelain mask bumps into a Scion in the crowd and murmurs sorry in a voice far too old. Then the child is gone, and so is the purse. A small white face looks back once from the mouth of an alley before it vanishes.

options.label: The fastest gives chase before the white face is gone for good.

outcomes.text: They catch the child and win back the purse, with more besides. Under the mask, the child is very old.
They lose the child in the crowd, along with the purse and two more taken during the chase.

options.label: Let the child keep it; whatever wears that mask needs it more.

outcomes.text: Somewhere, a small white face is grateful.

options.label: The sharpest watches where it runs, to learn where such things hide.

outcomes.text: It runs to a thieves' den with a back door you can use.
